name: How long does a faucet replacement take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a faucet replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The labor time to swap out an existing faucet typically ranges from 1 to 2 hours if the shutoff valves and plumbing lines are accessible and in good condition. When the installation happens as part of an extensive kitchen remodel, vanity replacement, or whole-home renovation, fixture installations are scheduled during the final trim-out phase. Project timing can extend if existing shutoff valves are frozen, supply lines need upgrading, or custom countertop hole drilling is required to accommodate your chosen fixture.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard faucet replacement takes 1 to 2 hours, though extensive remodel work or corroded shutoff valves can extend the installation timeline.
